picks.name: Flash Tattoo Party
picks.description: Living Häus Beer Co is throwing an Industry Night Flash Tattoo Party — cold beer in hand, walk in and pick a flash design. No appointment, just show up and leave with new ink.

picks.name: of Montreal & Sloppy Jane
picks.description: indie eccentrics of Montreal hit Wonder Ballroom. Theatrical, high-energy, and genuinely unlike anything else — costume changes, glam weirdness, and vocal rounds that you recognize, but you didn't know from where until you just googled them.

picks.name: Two Wheel Tuesday
picks.description: Living Häus's weekly bike-friendly hang — roll up, lock up, and enjoy a cold one with other two-wheeled Portlanders. No agenda, just bikes and good vibes on a Tuesday afternoon.

picks.name: Catch A Rising Star
picks.description: Champagne hosts a showcase of up-and-coming drag performers at Darcelle XV Showplace — fresh talent on one of Portland's most beloved stages. Expect sequins, surprises, and acts you'll be talking about after.

picks.name: Ty Curtis Band
picks.description: Free outdoor lunchtime music in the Lloyd District — the Ty Curtis Band brings soulful energy to the Hasalo Esplanade. Grab lunch from a nearby food cart and let the music do the rest.

picks.name: Tabor Dance
picks.description: Portland's weekly outdoor dance party. The vibes are always immaculate. Make sure to pack out all of your trash. Heck, pack out other people's trash too.

picks.name: Pickathon 2026
picks.description: The beloved indie festival kicks off at Pendarvis Farm in Happy Valley — intimate stages, thoughtful curation, and a crowd that loves music. If you haven't been to Pickathon, it's worth it.

picks.name: Golden Girls LIVE!
picks.description: Actors perform a full episode of The Golden Girls live on stage — costumes, props, and all the iconic lines. Portland audiences have made this a recurring institution for good reason. Bring your friends and prepare to quote along.

picks.name: Butcher's Burger
picks.description: MEATSTUFF on SE Foster — monthly burger special. Freshly ground beef, with specialty snacks while you wait in line. There's a reason why this gets busy - get there early if you can.

picks.name: Comedy in the Park
picks.description: Free outdoor stand-up comedy in Laurelhurst Park — professional headliners, no ticket required. Kickstand Comedy brings legit sets to one of Portland's prettiest outdoor settings. Grab a blanket and show up early for a good spot.

picks.name: Sellwood Street Fair
picks.description: One of Portland's most charming neighborhood fairs in one of its most charming neighborhoods — local vendors, live music, food, and that unhurried Sellwood energy. Free for all ages and a perfect summer Saturday.

picks.name: Timbers vs. Sounders
picks.description: The Cascadia Cup rivalry under the lights — Portland Timbers vs. Seattle Sounders at Providence Park. If you can't make the game, get to a bar and watch with your fellow Portlanders.

picks.name: N Portland Sunday Parkways
picks.description: Streets close to cars, bikes and pedestrians take over — Sunday Parkways returns to North Portland. Ride the route, hit free activities along the way, and enjoy the city at human speed. Family-friendly and quintessentially Portland.

picks.name: E Portland Tabletop Arcade
picks.description: Board games, card games, and tabletop RPGs at Multnomah County Library's Midland branch — if you like games and are looking for gaming friends, this is a super welcoming atmosphere. This month's theme is CHOO CHOO (train themed games).
